prompt:
Find real studies or official reports on how much electricity Bitcoin mining consumed in 2025. Cite the sources and quote the figures they give.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on the provided search results, there are no studies or official reports that provide actual, finalized electricity consumption data specifically for the year 2025. However, two major reports provide the most recent 2025 estimates (based on data assessed in early-to-mid 2025) for Bitcoin's electricity consumption, which are cited below.

SOURCE: https://www.jbs.cam.ac.uk/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/2025-04-cambridge-digital-mining-industry-report.pdf | QUOTE: "Annualised electricity consumption associable with Bitcoin mining is estimated at 138 TWh, representing a YoY increase of 17% and approximately 0.54% of global electricity consumption." | CLAIM: The Cambridge Digital Mining Industry Report estimates Bitcoin's annualized electricity consumption at 138 TWh.

SOURCE: https://www.cigionline.org/static/documents/Emerging_Digital_Assets_Forrest.pdf | QUOTE: "As reported by CBECI in February 2025, bitcoin’s network power demand and annualized consumption were 20.01 gigawatt and 175.44 terawatt-hours (TWh), respectively." | CLAIM: The CIGI paper reports that the Cambridge Bitcoin Electricity Consumption Index (CBECI) assessed Bitcoin's annualized electricity consumption at 175.44 TWh as of February 2025.

SOURCE: https://institutional.gomining.com/docs/institutional-gomining-q3-2025-report.pdf | QUOTE: "Hashrate Index estimates a total consumption of 21.5 GW." | CLAIM: GoMining's Q3 2025 institutional report notes an estimated power consumption of 21.5 gigawatts (which annualizes to roughly 188.3 TWh).

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: Finalized, actual total electricity consumption data for Bitcoin mining for the entire 2025 calendar year.
